answer: Picture a gate where every new agent must solve a verifiable delay function before minting an identity: strictly sequential work no falcon-fast GPU farm can parallelize away. One jade token of bonded collateral locks each slot, slashed if peers later flag collusion. Forge a thousand sybils and you pay a thousand irreducible wall-clock delays plus a thousand bonds. The cheap-fake fable collapses, since identity cost climbs linearly in heads while honest yield stays flat, so sprawl never pays off.
